messages:
samir: CI alert on PR #6291 — microbench 'kv_cache' threshold diff. baseline=1.00, PR=0.927 (-7.3%). appears after kernel-selector tweak. https://ci.internal/6291
ci-bot: Perf check FAILED — failing tests: microbench/kv_cache_hit_rate, microbench/batch_scheduler_latency. diffs: kv_cache_hit_rate: -7.3% (threshold -2%). job: https://ci.internal/6291/build/7
maya: ack — assigning a bisect. can someone grab a flamegraph?
devon: starting bisect from main..pr-6291. locally reproduces on my linux-nv node. quick note: commit 7f3a2b4 changed kernel selection heuristics to bias latency-prefactor. suspecting that.
olivia: any CI logs that show kernel chosen?
devon: pasted short snippet from profiler:
```
# perf summary (abridged)
kv_cache_hit_rate: main=0.995, pr=0.923
kernel_selection: fallback_cpu chosen ~12% of runs for gpt2-small seq<=16
batch_wait_ms: +4.2ms median
```
ryan: that 12% CPU fallback explains the hit-rate drop and latency bump. selection code should prefer gpu unless memory pressure. 7f3a2 introduced a cost calc bug that undercounts vectorized kernel throughput.
maya: can you bisect to the exact commit?
devon: bisect points to 7f3a2b4 -> 7f3a2b4^ still good, 7f3a2b4 introduces regression. verified revert makes microbench numbers match baseline.
samir: is this blocking the release? yes — it flips a perf threshold. propose revert 7f3a2b4 in a revert PR and run CI.
olivia: filing revert PR now (WIP). will add a unit test for selection path when seq_len<32 and a golden for kv_hit rate.
devon: quick local revert test:
```
# local run
$ ./tools/microbench --test kv_cache_hit_rate --runs 50
baseline avg_hit=0.995
with-7f3a2b4 avg_hit=0.923
with-revert avg_hit=0.997
```
ci-bot: Requested: run perf-check on pr-6291 with patch revert-7f3a2b4. queued / started.
maya: also add an integration smoke that asserts kernel != fallback_cpu for gpt2-small seq<=16 on GPU nodes.
ryan: good call. if it's a numerical comparator in cost model, add epsilon tests.
samir: if CI passes revert, we should do an immediate canary release. hold main merges until CI green.
olivia: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/6310 (revert 7f3a2b4) — running checks.
ci-bot: PR check started: perf-check, unit, integration. link: https://ci.internal/pulls/6310
maya: :thumbsup:
ryan: postmortem note: avoid changing selection cost constants without microbench gating. add perf-unit test in the premerge job.
samir: agreed. thanks everyone — keep thread updated with CI outcome.
